findings.rationale: The temporary Markdown materialization name is derived only from the source stem and process ID. Concurrent reentry in one process resolves the same input to the same file, and an existing sibling at that predictable path is truncated by write and then deleted by Drop. This can race active users or destroy an unrelated pre-existing file.

unparsed_clauses groups every statistical-property clause before every observed-property clause rather than preserving declaration source order. parse_checked_ai_project nevertheless treats element zero as the first offending clause, so a later statistical clause can supply the diagnostic location while an earlier observed clause is the actual first error.
